integrity_note: The majority operator and recursive binomial voting model are pre-existing. The new claim is the complete critical-ratio, parity and modal-depth limiting classification. Numerical checks corroborate; the proof is analytical. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete rooted regular directed trees; independent fair leaf valuations; fixed depth and fixed ratio; no arbitrary networks or correlations. Classical binomial limit machinery is used, and older recursive-voting equivalent reformulations remain a priority risk.
title: The critical majority-ratio phase diagram on random regular trees
